items.prompt_en: A school library has 3,45,000 books. How many more books does it need to reach 4 lakh?
items.prompt_hi: Ek school library mein 3,45,000 kitaabein hain. 4 lakh tak pahunchne ke liye aur kitni kitaabein chahiye?

items.prompt_en: A stadium sold 48,760 tickets. Rounded to the nearest thousand, how many tickets is that?
items.prompt_hi: Ek stadium ne 48,760 tickets beche. Nazdeeki hazaar tak round karne par yeh kitne tickets honge?

items.prompt_en: Without multiplying from scratch, find 25 × 400 if 25 × 4 = 100.
items.prompt_hi: Shuru se guna kiye bina 25 × 400 nikalo, agar 25 × 4 = 100 hai.

items.prompt_en: A bus ticket costs ₹35. Riya buys 3 tickets and pays ₹120. How many rupees should she get back?
items.prompt_hi: Bus ka ek ticket ₹35 ka hai. Riya 3 tickets leti hai aur ₹120 deti hai. Use kitne rupaye wapas milenge?

items.prompt_en: For a school event, calculate 80 − (12 + 8) × 3.
items.prompt_hi: School event ke liye 80 − (12 + 8) × 3 ka maan nikalo.

items.prompt_en: A bottle holds 7 tenths of a litre of juice. Write this amount as a decimal.
items.prompt_hi: Ek bottle mein litre ka 7 tenths juice hai. Is maatra ko decimal mein likho.

items.prompt_en: In the number 24.68, what is the value of the digit 6?
items.prompt_hi: Sankhya 24.68 mein digit 6 ka place value kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A runner completes two laps in 12.75 seconds and 13.4 seconds. What is the total time?
items.prompt_hi: Ek runner do laps 12.75 seconds aur 13.4 seconds mein poore karta hai. Kul samay kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: A notebook costs ₹n. What is the cost of 4 notebooks when n = 28?
items.prompt_hi: Ek notebook ki keemat ₹n hai. Jab n = 28 ho, toh 4 notebooks ki keemat kya hogi?

items.prompt_en: A cab charges ₹50 plus ₹12 per kilometre. If d is the distance in kilometres, find the charge when d = 5.
items.prompt_hi: Cab ₹50 aur har kilometre ke ₹12 leti hai. Agar doori d kilometres hai, toh d = 5 par kiraya nikalo.

items.prompt_en: Two straight roads cross. One angle at the crossing is 65°. What is the angle directly opposite it?
items.prompt_hi: Do seedhi sadkein ek-doosre ko kaat-ti hain. Crossing par ek kon 65° hai. Uske bilkul saamne wala kon kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: A straight path crosses two parallel railway tracks. One acute angle is 70°. What is its alternate interior angle?
items.prompt_hi: Ek seedha raasta do parallel railway tracks ko kaat-ta hai. Ek acute kon 70° hai. Uska alternate interior kon kitna hoga?

items.prompt_en: A taxi charges ₹40 plus ₹12 per kilometre. What is the fare for a 7 km trip?
items.prompt_hi: Ek taxi ₹40 ke saath har kilometre ke ₹12 leti hai. 7 km ke safar ka kiraya kitna hoga?

items.prompt_en: A pattern uses 3 tiles in row 1, 5 in row 2 and 7 in row 3. If it continues the same way, how many tiles are in row 10?
items.prompt_hi: Ek pattern mein pehli row mein 3, doosri mein 5 aur teesri mein 7 tiles hain. Isi tarah chalta rahe, toh 10vi row mein kitni tiles hongi?

items.prompt_en: Two straight roads cross. One angle at the crossing is 68°. What is the vertically opposite angle?
items.prompt_hi: Do seedhi sadkein ek-doosre ko kaat-ti hain. Crossing par ek angle 68° hai. Uske saamne wala vertically opposite angle kitna hai?

items.prompt_en: A straight road crosses two parallel streets. An angle at the first crossing is 115°. What is the corresponding angle at the second crossing?
items.prompt_hi: Ek seedhi sadak do parallel galiyon ko kaat-ti hai. Pehli crossing par ek angle 115° hai. Doosri crossing par uska corresponding angle kitna hoga?

items.prompt_en: Three odd-numbered houses have their house numbers added. Is the total odd or even?
items.prompt_hi: Teen odd-number wale gharon ke number jode jaate hain. Total odd hoga ya even?

options.text: Always odd
Always even
Odd only if the numbers are consecutive
Cannot be determined

items.prompt_en: A number pattern starts 2, 3. Each next number is the sum of the previous two. What is the seventh number?
items.prompt_hi: Ek number pattern 2, 3 se shuru hota hai. Har agla number pichhle do numbers ka sum hai. Saatva number kya hoga?

items.prompt_en: A triangular road sign has two angles measuring 48° and 67°. What is its third angle?
items.prompt_hi: Ek triangular road sign ke do angles 48° aur 67° hain. Teesra angle kitna hoga?

items.prompt_en: Riya drinks 3/4 of a 2/3-litre bottle of juice. How many litres does she drink?
items.prompt_hi: Riya 2/3-litre juice ki bottle ka 3/4 hissa peeti hai. Woh kitne litre juice peeti hai?

items.prompt_en: A cook has 3/4 kg of flour. Each roti needs 1/8 kg. How many rotis can the cook make?
items.prompt_hi: Ek cook ke paas 3/4 kg aata hai. Har roti ke liye 1/8 kg chahiye. Cook kitni rotis bana sakta hai?

items.prompt_en: Two triangular shelf brackets each have sides of 5 cm, 7 cm and 9 cm. What can you conclude about their shapes and sizes?
items.prompt_hi: Do triangular shelf brackets mein se har ek ki sides 5 cm, 7 cm aur 9 cm hain. Unki shape aur size ke baare mein kya keh sakte ho?

options.text: They are congruent
They must have different angles
They have equal perimeters but may have different shapes
They are congruent only if they have the same orientation

items.prompt_en: A game deducts 6 points for each missed shot. What is the total change in score after 4 missed shots?
items.prompt_hi: Ek game mein har missed shot par 6 points kat-te hain. 4 missed shots ke baad score mein kul kitna badlav hoga?

items.prompt_en: A team’s score fell by 45 points equally over 5 rounds. What was the change in score per round?
items.prompt_hi: Ek team ka score 5 rounds mein har round barabar girte hue kul 45 points gira. Har round mein score ka badlav kitna tha?

items.prompt_en: A school has 84 notebooks and 126 pens. It makes the greatest possible number of identical prize packs, using everything. How many packs can it make?
items.prompt_hi: School ke paas 84 notebooks aur 126 pens hain. Sab cheezein istemal karke ek jaise prize packs ki sabse zyada sankhya kitni hogi?

items.prompt_en: Two buses leave a stop together. One returns every 18 minutes, the other every 24 minutes. After how many minutes will they next be there together?
items.prompt_hi: Do buses ek stop se saath nikalti hain. Ek har 18 minute mein aur doosri har 24 minute mein lautti hai. Ve agli baar kitne minute baad saath hongi?

items.prompt_en: A shopkeeper packs 48 mangoes and 60 oranges into the greatest possible number of identical bags, with no fruit left. How many oranges go in each bag?
items.prompt_hi: Dukaandaar 48 aam aur 60 santre bina kuch bachaye ek jaise bags mein baantta hai. Agar bags ki sankhya sabse zyada ho, toh har bag mein kitne santre honge?

items.prompt_en: A ribbon costs ₹12.50 per metre. Meera buys 2.4 metres. How many rupees does she pay?
items.prompt_hi: Ribbon ki keemat ₹12.50 prati metre hai. Meera 2.4 metre khareedti hai. Woh kitne rupaye degi?

items.prompt_en: A cyclist covers 13.5 km in 0.75 hour at a steady speed. What is the speed in kilometres per hour?
items.prompt_hi: Ek cyclist barabar raftaar se 0.75 ghante mein 13.5 km chalti hai. Uski raftaar kilometre prati ghanta mein kitni hai?

items.prompt_en: Riya's practice scores are 6, 8, 8, 9 and 14. What is the median score?
items.prompt_hi: Riya ke practice scores 6, 8, 8, 9 aur 14 hain. Inka median score kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A news chart shows road accidents fell from 40 in June to 30 in July. Which statement is supported by these figures?
items.prompt_hi: News chart mein road accidents June mein 40 aur July mein 30 dikhaye gaye hain. In aankdon se kaunsa statement sahi hai?
items.answer: July had 10 fewer accidents than June.

options.text: July had 10 fewer accidents than June.
July had 10% fewer accidents than June.
June had 10 fewer accidents than July.
The chart proves roads became safer.

verified.solverAnswer: July had 10 fewer accidents than June.

items.prompt_en: You need to compare the number of students choosing cricket, football and badminton in two classes. Which display makes comparing the classes for each sport easiest?
items.prompt_hi: Do classes mein cricket, football aur badminton chunne wale students ki sankhya compare karni hai. Har sport ke liye classes compare karne ka sabse aasan display kaunsa hai?
items.answer: A paired bar graph with two bars for each sport

options.text: A paired bar graph with two bars for each sport
A single bar showing the total across all sports
A list of only the most popular sport in each class
A line graph with dates on the horizontal axis

verified.solverAnswer: A paired bar graph with two bars for each sport

items.prompt_en: Aarav wants to construct the perpendicular bisector of a line segment using a compass and ruler. Where should he place the compass point to draw the first pair of arcs?
items.prompt_hi: Aarav compass aur ruler se line segment ka perpendicular bisector banana chahta hai. Pehli jodi arcs banane ke liye compass ki nok kahan rakhe?
items.answer: At each endpoint of the segment

options.text: At each endpoint of the segment
Only at the estimated midpoint
Anywhere above the segment
At one endpoint and then at the estimated midpoint

verified.solverAnswer: At each endpoint of the segment

items.prompt_en: A floor is tiled using only identical regular polygons, with no gaps or overlaps. Which tile shape can meet four at a corner?
items.prompt_hi: Floor par sirf ek jaise regular polygon tiles bina gap ya overlap ke lagaye gaye hain. Kis shape ke chaar tiles ek kone par mil sakte hain?

options.text: Square
Equilateral triangle
Regular hexagon
Regular pentagon

items.prompt_en: Kabir buys three identical notebooks and a ₹12 pen for ₹87 altogether. What is the price of one notebook?
items.prompt_hi: Kabir teen ek jaise notebooks aur ₹12 ka pen khareedta hai. Kul ₹87 lagte hain. Ek notebook ki keemat kitni hai?

items.prompt_en: A phone plan charges ₹80 plus ₹5 per GB of data. Priya's bill is ₹155. How many GB did she use?
items.prompt_hi: Phone plan mein ₹80 fixed charge aur har GB data ke ₹5 lagte hain. Priya ka bill ₹155 hai. Usne kitne GB data istemal kiya?
